The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8080` (see `WeaviateBuilder.WeaviateHttpPort`)
- Port: `50051` (see `WeaviateBuilder.WeaviateGrpcPort`)
- Environment variable: `AUTHENTICATION_ANONYMOUS_ACCESS_ENABLED=true`
- Environment variable: `PERSISTENCE_DATA_PATH=/var/lib/weaviate`
- Wait strategy: Waits until a TCP port is available from within the container itself.
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /v1/.well-known/ready` to port `8080` is completed successfully.
